lesson_title: Equations of Motion: The Absent Character Trick
hook_text: Four equations. One always fits. Stop guessing which — use the missing character.
clip_script: Notice what I did as I read each one: I named the missing character. Each equation is missing exactly one of the five quantities — and that missing character is the entire secret of choosing. Because every problem gives you three quantities and asks for a fourth: the fifth one, the one neither given nor wanted, is the one your equation must not contain. Find the absent character; pick the equation that excludes it. Chosen not by luck, not by trying each — by the absence of time.
visual_style: Five character cards (vi, vf, a, t, Δx) on screen; the absent one dims and slides away, and the matching equation glows and locks in.
pacing: Quick setup of the five characters, dramatic dim of the absent one, instant payoff.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and solve the 300 m problem start to finish.
